controls.case_identity: Local control labels only; not new ledger/RUN identifiers.
controls.execution_policy: Each phase executes the complete frozen applicable case table; normal execution rows must pass real validate_lock before execute_locked. Metadata, terminal-package mutations and explicitly named legacy seams are counted separately. No scientific module is imported or scientific case evaluated. No required case is silently skipped; unsupported host/control remains unexercised and prevents readiness until actually completed on a supported declared host.
controls.fixture_ID_scope: Allocated RUN-QA identity is reused only across separate explicitly synthetic fixture Git roots/local case namespaces. These are not global scientific run records and are never installed under real experiments/runs. Outer actual producer/native/task provenance is separate from clearly labeled fixture authority/native metadata.
controls.mutation_policy: Fresh valid committed fixture per case. Change exactly the stated property; update only non-target enclosing byte references/fixture commits needed to reach that guard. Preserve before/after bytes, hashes and exact mutation recipe. No production validator/resource/tree/identity guard is monkeypatched to obtain a positive result; only the explicitly labeled root simulation and pure metadata/legacy-seam controls use their stated seams.
controls.repeat_policy: Development attempts may repeat after actual code changes only in fresh numbered attempt directories; retain every failed attempt, its source hashes and all raw evidence. Completion requires a full final-table pass bound to unchanged final code; no cherry-picking rows across versions. Independent QA uses a separately constructed driver and fresh fixtures.

baseline_fixture.normal: A supported POSIX nonroot fixture, one benign child, outer wall10seconds/CPU null/memory512MiB unless a row overrides. Baseline worker touches8MiB and remains alive at least0.2seconds to permit actual monitor sampling, then emits inert deterministic profile bytes and a private finite report. Sampled RSS remains an observed value, never assumed from the allocation. No scientific imports.
baseline_fixture.private_report: One length-bounded finite JSON document on private FD with exact status, instrument_valid, controls_passed, comparison_eligible, failure_kind, metrics, protected-config echo and emitted artifact inventory. No arbitrary nested executable data. Parent independently recomputes file/provenance/status checks.
baseline_fixture.receipt_mutants: Reuse complete baseline bytes only as a declared input copy for zero-new-child terminal validation mutants; every mutation is its own retained local case. Do not report these as additional executed launches.

steps: Read-only validate_lock parses strict documents, verifies externally pinned approval/grant, exact profile/slot/12-case inventory, current source closure, actual interpreter and plan environment, parent-bound native capsule and live claim. No experiment/fixture worker, output allocation or scientific import occurs here; separately counted bounded read-only administrative helpers may verify actual Git/ref/version facts.

execute_locked accepts only an unconsumed same-process issued capability, confirms a single-threaded launching context, and repeats current claim/time/source/lock/grant and clean-tree checks before exclusive output directory creation. Consume the token exactly once; a failed attempt cannot be resumed into the same output namespace.
